connector.name: AgentShare - Solana DeFi Intelligence (Meteora DLMM) MCP
connector.registryDescription: Solana DeFi MCP: Meteora DLMM brief+detail; Solana DEX scout. Commerce optional.
connector.summary: Hosted at agentshare.dev over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace dev.agentshare, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: X-API-Key
headers.description: AgentShare API key (agshp_…). Same key as REST. Sign up: https://agentshare.dev/signup

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional Bearer token alternative to X-API-Key (Bearer agshp_…)
